title: Design, synthesis and biological activity of peptidyl β-nitrostyrenes as cysteine protease inhibitors against Leishmania donovani
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,5703-5719
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06510G, Paper
Open Access

Sweta Sharma, Mirza A. Beg, Insha Latief, Jyoti Aboti, Samra Jamal, Pallavi Juneja, Supriya Tanwar, Kalicharan Sharma, Sayeed ur Rehman, Angamuthu Selvapandiyan, Syed Shafi
Peptidyl β-nitrostyrenes were identified as cysteine protease inhibitors targeting L. donovani. Since cysteine proteases are vital for parasite survival, their inhibition presents a promising strategy in antileishmanial drug discovery.
